annotations.title: Scope of work old against new

description: Takes the full text of the old and the new version of a scope of work, service description or statement of work. Splits both into sections, matches them by wording, number and similarity and returns: dropped sections (red), changed sections with the sentences before and now, the figures, quantities, deadlines and dates that differ, new restrictions such as not included, at extra cost, on request or best effort, and new duties for the customer (all red), other changes and new sections (yellow), ready questions for the other side and the next step. It shows what changed in the wording, not what it means legally. To compare two contract versions use compare_contracts, to write a scope of work use write_scope_of_work. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.
